title: Scaling & Resource Limits in Perf Testing

scenes.say: Ever wonder why your app slows down under heavy load? Let's find out where the real limits are.

scenes.label: Scaling
scenes.sub: Performance tests reveal if you hit CPU, memory, or network limits.
scenes.say: Performance tests show when you hit CPU, memory, or network limits. That's when scaling matters.
You can scale horizontally by adding more servers, or vertically by upgrading hardware. Each approach has trade-offs.

scenes.title: Stress Test Output
scenes.say: When CPU maxes out and throughput stalls, adding more app instances can boost performance. That's scaling in action.

scenes.question: What if you ignore resource limits?
scenes.right: You risk crashes, errors, and bad user experience if you ignore resource limits.
scenes.say: Don't ignore resource limits. Doing so can lead to crashes, errors, and unhappy users.
